title: loomlc verdict
description: A review step's judgement of the change on the branch.

verdict.description: pass when the change is ready for a human reviewer, fail when anything in findings must be fixed first.

summary.description: What was verified and how. On a pass this becomes the pull request's QA section.

findings.description: Every defect the change must fix. Empty on a pass.

detail.description: What's wrong and what has to change.

path.description: The file the finding is in, relative to the repository root. Empty when it isn't about one file. A path, not prose: no newlines or backticks.

line.description: The line the finding is on. Zero when it isn't about one line.
